properties.name: Chosin Reservoir
properties.description: Artificial reservoir on the Changjin River; frozen solid in winter, surface used as an escape route by Task Force Faith survivors

properties.name: Taebaek Western Ridgeline
properties.description: Dominant high ground west of reservoir; used by PVA 20th Army for infiltration and attack positions

properties.name: Taebaek Eastern Ridgeline
properties.description: High ground east of reservoir; PVA 27th Army infiltration route and attack positions against Task Force Faith

properties.name: Main Supply Route (MSR) — Route 1
properties.description: The single road linking Hungnam through Koto-ri, Hagaru-ri to Yudam-ni; the lifeline and escape route for all UN forces at Chosin

properties.name: Yudam-ni
properties.description: Northernmost UN position; held by 5th and 7th Marine Regiments; starting point of the famous fighting breakout south

properties.name: Hagaru-ri
properties.description: Central logistics hub; site of the emergency airstrip that evacuated 4,312 casualties; key to the entire division's survival

properties.name: Koto-ri
properties.description: Southern UN strongpoint; assembly area before the final push through Funchilin Pass to Hungnam

properties.name: Funchilin Pass
properties.description: A steep, single-lane road clinging to a cliff face at 4,000ft elevation; site of the famous treadway bridge airdrop; the last major obstacle before the coastal plain

properties.name: Hungnam
properties.description: Port city; site of Operation Christmas Cargo — the evacuation of 105,000 UN troops and 98,000 Korean refugees by sea

properties.name: Changjin River
properties.description: River feeding the reservoir; frozen in winter but terrain channelizes movement
